summary: Apply GHG Protocol categories, prioritize supplier data, and build a practical Scope 3 governance plan. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Scope 3 emissions training helps procurement and sustainability professionals assess value-chain emissions using supplier data. Participants screen categories, choose spend-based or supplier-specific calculation methods, assess data quality, prioritize supplier engagement and document reporting controls for purchasing decisions. Exercises use spreadsheets to create a category screen, supplier-prioritization matrix and data-governance plan, while introducing AI-assisted supplier-data screening conceptually.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who handle supplier decisions, value-chain emissions data, Scope 3 reporting, or assurance processes.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with procurement, supplier data, sustainability reporting, finance, or audit workflows is expected. No programming is required. Spreadsheet-based exercises use sample or participant-approved data; do not bring confidential supplier information.
